in_marathi.name: Jivanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Living, Conscious, Vibrant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jivanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jivanta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jiv' which means 'living' or 'conscious'. It is a name given to those who are believed to have a vibrant and lively spirit. The name is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to various deities and figures who embody the essence of life and consciousness.
